jobs.prompt: A dignified elderly court official stands upright with both hands clasped together in front of the waist. The hands stay together. He breathes calmly, shifts his weight slightly and slowly looks left then forward. Feet stay flat and planted. Subtle natural full-body idle, no large arm gestures.

An armored guard stands upright at ease with the right hand holding a tall polearm vertically beside the body. The left arm rests close to the torso. Subtle breathing, gentle head turns and a small balanced shift of weight. Both feet remain flat on the ground. Natural calm idle motion.

A rider sits steadily on a horse with legs apart and bent knees. The pelvis stays on the saddle. Both hands hold reins near the waist. Gentle natural breathing, a small head turn, slight coordinated movement of shoulders and forearms. Calm seated idle, no standing or dismounting.
